lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Welcome to my training grounds. Nothing in here can hurt you, and nothing in here is permanent.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Read the notice boards and try what they say. Controls are by the start, melee is east, supplies are further east, archery is north and the dodging range is north-east.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: While you stand in here your weapons are enchanted, so heavy attacks (K) work. In the dungeons you will need the upgrade from the merchant.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Potions and bombs from the stands are only lent to you. They go back when you leave, so use them freely.

lines.speaker: sage
lines.text: Only this: a dummy never hits back, but a dungeon does. Come back whenever you need a refresher.
